provenance.boundary: The archive preserves all registered text/source packets and their verified hashes. Its 28 declared/located lineage-gap records do not imply 28 missing PDFs or missing source text; DBiT includes a repository text/code bundle and a plain TSV artifact for which separate binary ancestry may not apply. Native publication XML is preserved as native markup. Custody associations do not prove upstream acquisition completeness, visual inspection, rendition fidelity, complete Methods or scientific support.
provenance.gap_classification_boundary: The 28 records retain the archive collector label binary_provenance_not_declared_or_located. This is a classification of declared/located lineage, not a count of missing PDFs, not proof that each source requires a separate binary ancestor, and not missing scientific source text. All 28 registered source-byte hashes are preserved. No corrected count of missing original binaries can be established from that label alone.

native_accounting.reasoning_privacy: Only event envelope labels, thread identifiers, terminal turn usage and command-item type labels were inspected. Agent reasoning, messages, command text and command output payloads were not decoded or emitted. Reasoning-output-token counts are numerical usage metadata only.
native_accounting.boundary: Counts describe recorded native CLI work and recorded token usage, not billing cost, backend identity, complete source isolation, comprehension, or scientific correctness.
native_accounting.usage_interpretation: Input totals are recorded request-accounting sums, including cached input across turns; they are not unique source tokens. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets of their respective input/output totals and must not be added again.

tooling_notes: The workspace-root .venv/bin/python was absent; the successful audit used sequencing-technology-atlas/.venv/bin/python (Python 3.13.8).
An exploratory display assumed manifest members were a list and stopped with KeyError; corrected to the actual dict schema before verification.
An exploratory rg included one absent common.py path; this did not affect the audit.
An initial closure definition excluded any stage with an error event; corrected to require final turn.completed. The ddRAD integrator recorded four intermediate error events and then completed.

Two prior original-binding receipts lack their historic paths in the archive original_paths index, but their exact bytes and SHA-256 are preserved as phase/sources/{drop-seq,atac-seq}/prior_original_bindings.json; reported explicitly. Last paths were not rewritten.
